content.value_statement: Creating a reusable AI skill can lead to unclear triggers, unnecessary context, and inconsistent resource layouts. This skill provides a structured process for planning, validating, and packaging focused skills.
actual_capabilities: Guides authors through planning a skill from concrete user requests.
Explains how to organize SKILL.md, scripts, references, and assets.
Creates a starter skill directory with an initializer script.
Validates required frontmatter, naming rules, and description limits.
Packages a validated skill directory into a local .skill archive.
limitations: It provides guidance and templates, not domain-specific skill content.
The validator checks basic structure only and does not assess usefulness or security of bundled code.
Packaging includes files in the selected directory, so authors must review contents first.
The tool does not publish packages or install them for other users.

use_cases.title: Create a first skill
use_cases.description: Turn a repeated task into a small skill with clear triggering metadata and a focused workflow.

use_cases.title: Standardize team skills
use_cases.description: Use a common structure for team documentation, helper scripts, and reusable templates.

use_cases.title: Prepare a distributable package
use_cases.description: Validate a finished skill and create a local .skill archive for controlled sharing.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a simple skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a skill for reviewing weekly support tickets. Ask for the minimum details needed, then propose its name, trigger description, and sections.

prompt_templates.title: Design resource folders
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building a skill for invoice processing. Recommend which repeatable tasks belong in scripts, references, and assets. Explain why each resource is needed.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an existing skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill structure and suggest changes that reduce context use while preserving important workflows and references.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for packaging
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pre-packaging checklist for my skill. Cover frontmatter, unused example files, bundled scripts, references, and files that should not be shared.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for recurring release-note reviews.
output: Trigger description: Review release notes for clarity, completeness, and audience-specific impact.
Recommended resources: a review checklist in references and an optional release-note template in assets.

output_examples.input: What should I validate before packaging a skill?
output: Confirm that name and description are present in frontmatter.
Review every bundled file before creating the local package.

best_practices: Start with real user requests before writing instructions.
Keep SKILL.md focused and move detailed material into referenced files.
Review and test every bundled script before packaging.
anti_patterns: Do not add generic knowledge that the AI tool already understands.
Do not keep unused sample files in the finished skill.
Do not describe triggering conditions only in the skill body.

faq.question: What is a skill?
faq.answer: A skill is a focused package of instructions and optional resources for a recurring task.

faq.question: When should I add a script?
faq.answer: Add a script when deterministic work is repeated and the script has been tested.

faq.question: What belongs in SKILL.md?
faq.answer: Keep essential workflow guidance, triggering metadata, and links to optional resources in SKILL.md.

faq.question: Can I include reference documents?
faq.answer: Yes. Use reference documents for detailed material that is needed only for specific tasks.

faq.question: What does validation check?
faq.answer: Validation checks basic frontmatter, required fields, naming rules, and description limits.

faq.question: Does packaging publish my skill?
faq.answer: No. Packaging creates a local .skill archive. You control any later sharing or publication.
